name: Ponderings of Time
source:
What is time?

Does every choice you make drastically affect the world? Can you throw a watermelon from a table if there’s only apples in the fruit bowl? Will eating a banana cause you to die at age 15?

Ponderings of Time tries to explain what time is, discusses various theories of time, and attempts to tie it all back together to relate to visual novels.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305121412/http://skiesofamber.vnovel.com/ponderings-of-time]official site[/url]]
translation:
时间是什么？

你做出的每个选择都会彻底影响世界吗？如果水果碗里只有苹果，你能从桌上扔出一个西瓜吗？吃下香蕉会让你在15岁时死去吗？

《时间沉思录》试图解释时间是什么，讨论各种时间理论，并将这些内容重新联系起来，探讨它们与视觉小说的关系。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305121412/http://skiesofamber.vnovel.com/ponderings-of-time]官方网站[/url]]
